messages:
maya: heads up — after the KMS rotate last night we're seeing a strange authz fallback for embedding routes. some calls are being accepted but served by chat model variant (not embeddings).

raj: do you have logs or a request id?

maya: yea grabbed a few. pattern is: keytag after rotation lacks scope metadata -> authz layer treats token as legacy -> polyfallback to chat-route. sample log: 
```
INFO 2026-03-18T02:14:12Z request_id=req-3b9e authz=warn keytag=rot-20260317 meta_found=false allowed_scopes=[chat/text.generate] requested_scopes=[embeddings.create:model-x] outcome=fallback_to_chat
```

amelia: rotbot confirmed the rotation succeeded but we used the v1 rewrap path. does that path preserve key metadata?

rotbot: rotation-event: id=rot-20260317 user=infra trigger=auto method=v1-rewrap status=success

kevin: if metadata didn't persist we should fail closed, not silently fallback. that can leak embeddings to a different route.

maya: agreed. impact looks low (few internal QA calls) but this is a visible policy regression. audit logs show scope mismatch entries but no explicit "deny" which made services fallback.

raj: quick triage Qs: 1) which code path allows fallback when route is embeddings-only? 2) does KMS rewrap drop user-defined tags/annotations? 3) can we revert to previous key while we fix?

amelia: answers: 1) authz fallback happens in route_resolver: if per-route scope check fails and "allow_compatible_fallbacks" is true it picks alternative model categories. 2) v1-rewrap does not copy customer metadata tags; v2-preserve does. 3) we can rebind old key but rotation purged previous material after 24h per policy — ops might still have snapshot.

maya: proposed mitigation: a) disable allow_compatible_fallbacks for embeddings routes (hotfix) b) add strict deny on missing key metadata c) block further v1-rewrap rotations until we add metadata-copy.

kevin: +1 to all. please file an incident if any customer-facing calls exist. Also add an audit alert for scope-presence=false on rotation events.

raj: I'll open a short-lived feature-flag hotfix: in route_resolver default fallback=false for routes with attribute "embeddings_only". patch: 
```
// hotfix
if route.attr == "embeddings_only" and not has_scope(token, "embeddings.create"):
  reject_request(status=403, reason="missing_scope")
else:
  // previous behavior
```

amelia: ops: searching snapshots now. rotbot: can you emit list of keys touched during rot-20260317?

rotbot: keys_rotated=[rot-20260317:alias/ri-service, rot-20260317:alias/ingest-worker] snapshots_available=true

maya: created internal eval with synthetic embedding requests to verify. after hotfix we should see explicit 403s and no silent model swap.

kevin: also add a post-rotate test to CI: ensure metadata roundtrip after any rewrap variant. add unit test for policy enforcement when key metadata missing.

raj: assigning: raj -> hotfix flag + rollout, amelia -> KMS metadata fix (v2-preserve path + migration script), maya -> incident note + customer ping if we find external calls, kevin -> postmortem owner. ETA: hotfix in 30m, rotation migration 2 days.

maya: small note — audit team requested we tag rotation logs with route hints (embed/chat) to make forensics easier.

kevin: good. also add a temporary alert: rate of fallback_to_chat > 0 for embeddings routes -> P1 page.

maya: ok ordering: hotfix -> confirm with synthetic tests -> snapshot restore if needed -> patch KMS rewrap -> permanent deny by default for embeddings.

amal: (typo) meant amelia earlier.

raj: pulling branch now. will update thread with rollout status. :rocket:

maya: thanks everyone.
